name: hbfd_rly_624_we_fc

pin_regs.reason: F1 relay = ONE register stage at the pins by definition: i is captured by the stage register, o leaves it through the matched forwarding buffer; a pin register would add a cycle per hop and break the clk_out / o driver match (DIE-CLOCK F1)

structural_change: F1 forwarded-clock variant of hbfd_rly_624_WE (owner neighbour-relative clocking; DIE-CLOCK form F1): same ot_hbm_rly stage on clk_in, clk_out + every o through one kept BUFx12f each, data face 114.48 um (<= 6 pins/um; was 64.8), outline 21.6 x 114.48. fc2: the clk_out buffer input is held off the clk_in net through CTS and reconnected to the root (fc1: TritonCTS made it a tree sink, clk_in->clk_out 58 ps through CTS buffers); forwarded-hop min separation 85 / 55 ps (fc1 50 ps padded the 624 inputs: native capture 193.5)

job.purpose: HBM die F1 forwarded-clock relay hbfd_rly_624_WE_fc: register on clk_in, clk_out = kept BUFx12f, o through the same cell on the downstream face beside clk_out; i/clk_in upstream (W), o/clk_out downstream (E), rs S; 21.6 x 114.48 um, M5 cap
